in_hebrew.name: Min
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Min הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘minos’ which means ‘beloved’. In Greek mythology, Minos was a king of Crete, known for his wisdom and justice. In Christianity, the name Min carries the symbolism of love, devotion, and kindness.
